preamble: Middle Chinese [dʒ] (崇 group, Baxter dzr-) gave the fricative [ʂ] in a subset of oblique-tone Mandarin words, chiefly in the 止 rime class, rather than the regular unaspirated affricate [ʈʂ] (see j_affricate_to_ch_retroflex). The outcome is lexically restricted. The phonetic value of this initial is disputed: Zhengzhang Shangfang reconstructs the 莊 series as postalveolar [tʃ tʃʰ dʒ ʃ], which is the value used here, while Karlgren, Pulleyblank and Pan Wuyun reconstruct retroflex [ɖʐ].
